verdict.rationale: Stripe documents several ways to register smart readers to an account: registration code, serial number, or order number. Serial-number registration works without physical access, so a reader can be used 'immediately after you unbox it'. Readers can be managed from the Dashboard, and no-code options let merchants accept payments on a compatible reader. However, the evidence does not show a time-to-first-payment measured in minutes, and readers must first be assigned to a location. missing for 10: evidence of an end-to-end pair-and-pay flow completed within minutes, documentation of pairing steps for Bluetooth/mobile readers, hands-on or independent corroboration of setup speed.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can pair a card reader with the POS app or register it to my account and take a payment within minutes

citations.quote: You can register readers using their serial number. This method doesn’t require someone to physically have the reader to register it, so you can use it immediately after you unbox it.
You can register smart readers in one of three ways: - Registration code - Serial number - Order number
You must register your reader to a location to accept payments.
Reader management: Order, register, configure, and monitor readers from the Dashboard.
Accept in-person payments on a compatible reader using Stripe's no-code solution.
